==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "EPISODE TITLE" with the appropriate episode name.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Acolyte|''EPISODE TITLE''|''FORMATTED TITLE'' (optional)}}

This template is intended to be used to cite information from the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' television series and to list its episodes, such as in the Appearances sections of [[in-universe]] articles.
